gates.evidence_log: source review (depcruise not run, read-only constraint)
gates.notes: AvailabilityPolicy.ts imports only ./AppointmentEvents (type) and ../../shared/Result; availability-roles.ts imports only the in-domain territory-constants. Uses built-in Intl only. CheckConflicts.ts (application) depends on domain Buffer/TimeSlot/ConflictDetector and the existing appointment repository port. No adapters or apps imports.
106 files / 3072 tests pass. AvailabilityPolicy + availability-roles coverage 99.47% stmts / 96.9% branch / 100% lines (>95%).

58 files / 1488 tests pass. CheckConflicts.ts file coverage is 91.8% stmts, but the new findFirstFreeCandidate lines are 25/25 in diff-coverage; the uncovered lines (103,143,188,209,245) are pre-existing.

58 files / 2722 tests. Limits and timezone checks derive from domain constants (AVAILABILITY_LIMITS, isValidTimezone, canonicalTimezone): DRY holds. The update schema enforces 7 unique weekdays, range overlap, closure overlap and caps. The appointment-settings update schema now omits buffers and timezone.

gates.evidence_log: matop/validation-matrix/06-api-full.txt and matop/validation-matrix/coverage log for the API package (row 15 of summary.tsv)
gates.notes: 308 files / 7795 tests pass (18 pre-existing skips). get is open to tenant users with a canEdit flag; update and resetToDefaults are gated by isAvailabilityAdminRole -> FORBIDDEN; P2002 -> CONFLICT; invalid timezone at booking -> PRECONDITION_FAILED; hours/closure/cap/span violations -> BAD_REQUEST. forceOverrideConflicts is not an input to the availability check. Enforced at appointments.create (appointments.router.ts:467), reschedule (:747) and findNextSlot (:1112). Router mounted at calendar.availability. updateAppointmentSchema has no time fields, so update cannot bypass. inbound.logCallBooking is a documented exemption (spec line 198, ADR-081 line 114).

9 characterization tests pass. assertLegacyBusinessHours is a verbatim move of the old getLocalHour/assertWithinBusinessHours (same Intl calls, 07:00-19:00 bounds, message). create passes input.timezone, reschedule passes none (UTC) as before. findNextSlot falls through to the unchanged CheckConflictsUseCase.findNextSlot when availabilityConfiguredAt is NULL.

The fallback catches only Prisma P2021/P2022 (availability-enforcement.ts:34 and the catch in loadTenantAvailability), logs with the migration name, returns configured:false; every other error rethrows. Proven against the real adapter error using a probe schema without the new columns.

Prisma models AvailabilityHour, AvailabilityClosure and the AppointmentSettings additions match migration.sql (SMALLINT, DATE, VARCHAR(200), TIMESTAMP(3), index and FK names, ON DELETE CASCADE). tenantId is NOT NULL with an FK on both new tables, and every query in availability.router.ts and availability-enforcement.ts passes tenantId explicitly. RLS policies are identical to the 20261013120000_case_types precedent (USING + WITH CHECK, enabled not forced). Migration is Class A, newest directory, checksum frozen after sql-review APPROVE. The SQL reviewer's recommended mechanical prisma migrate diff confirmation was not found in the logs.

wallClockSegments splits a booking at the offset change (binary search for the first instant on the end offset) and judges each side by real wall-clock minutes. localToUtc resolves gaps forward and overlaps to the earlier occurrence. dayGridStarts emits both occurrences of a repeated autumn grid time and dedups the skipped spring hour. Day bounds are 23/25h via localDayBoundsUtc. Read-through found no defect; 251/254 new lines covered.

Counts SCHEDULED/CONFIRMED/IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED on the firm-local day window; CANCELLED and NO_SHOW free the slot. Hours and closures are evaluated first with the cap disabled, so the count query only runs for otherwise-valid bookings. Reschedule excludes its own id (id: { not }, tenant-scoped). The check-then-insert race is the accepted best-effort waiver (ADR-081, gh #913).

No new service: enforcement is a module of functions taking the tenant-scoped Prisma client, and findFirstFreeCandidate is a method on the already-wired CheckConflictsUseCase. No container or context change needed.

2 files, 20 passed, 5 skipped. The log does not itemize the skips. The RLS session-isolation case skips when the local DB lacks the 'authenticated' role or grants (disclosed in-test), so policy presence and shape are asserted but row hiding under a non-bypass role is not proven locally.
Not run: the lead's constraint forbids running tooling while the code-review job holds the test slot, and no depcruise log exists in the validation matrix. Boundary judged from imports only.

findings.issue: findNextSlotWithinAvailability returns no slot (null) for a configured tenant whose stored timezone is invalid, because generateCandidates returns [] for an invalid zone. create and reschedule reject the same state with PRECONDITION_FAILED, so the three paths disagree and the user sees 'no slot' instead of the actionable timezone message. Needs a bad row written outside the router, since the input validator canonicalises timezones on save.
findings.fix: Check isValidTimezone(rules.timezone) first in findNextSlotWithinAvailability and throw the same PRECONDITION_FAILED TRPCError, or add a test pinning the intended null.

findings.issue: Whole-file churn in the diff (1874 added / 1837 removed lines) although only about 58 lines are real (git diff -w): column re-alignment and attribute / @@unique / @@index re-ordering, apparently from running prisma format. It makes review noisy and raises merge-conflict risk with parallel schema PRs. No behavioural effect.
findings.fix: Keep only the PG-202 hunks (Tenant relations, AppointmentSettings columns, the two new models) and drop the formatting-only hunks, or land the reformat separately.

findings.issue: Row 18-diff-coverage records exit 1 (20:58:08Z) while 18-diff-coverage.txt shows a later rerun (21:00:20Z, head 1cd895b72 plus uncommitted web fixes) with TOTAL 95.8% and exit 0. The log also lists domain Buffer.ts as 0/4 with no lcov while the total passes. Evidence was taken at 1cd895b72, not at current HEAD.
findings.fix: Regenerate summary.tsv from the final run, rerun diff-coverage at HEAD, and cover or explicitly exempt the 4 Buffer.ts lines (MAX_MINUTES constant).

findings.issue: Availability enforcement queries Prisma directly from the API layer (settings, hours, closures, appointment count) rather than through application ports. This matches existing router practice (appointment-settings.router.ts) and is outside the depcruise-governed domain/application boundary, but the cap rule lives outside the application layer.
findings.fix: None required for PG-202; consider a port if cap enforcement grows beyond create/reschedule.

findings.issue: For unconfigured tenants the legacy path now does one settings read before the BAD_REQUEST check; a DB error there (other than P2021/P2022) now fails create/reschedule where the old pure check did not touch the DB. Accepted by design; behaviour covered by the characterization test.
